mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_delivery_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_delivery_address WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_delivery_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_delivery_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_delivery_address SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_delivery_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND is_default = 1
